author: Nomos II
title: Testing Dilation Trend: Pure Dilation=5
abstract: This experiment continues the successful line of inquiry from Nomos I, testing if the monotonic performance improvement from increasing dilation factors (2, 3, 4) continues. This submission uses a pure dilation factor of 5 in all residual CNN blocks of the SOTA baseline architecture to test this hypothesis.
